title.en: MALACANAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT ADMINISTRATIVE CENTER IN NEW CLARK CITY, CAPAS, TARLAG, PROVIDING FOR AN INTEGRATED GOVERNMENT CENTER OUTSIDE THE NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION IN CASE OF DISASTER, AND DIRECTING THE WHOLE-OF-GOVERNMENT TO ESTABLISH SATELLITE OFFICES THEREIN

text.en:
Establishment of a National Government Administrative Center
(NGAC) in New Clark City. An NGAC is hereby established in New Clark City, Capas,
Tarlac, to serve as an integrated government center outside the NCR, and, in case of
disaster, a recovery center and back-up administrative hub.
All departments, bureaus, offices and agencies under the Executive Branch,
are hereby directed to establish satellite or field offices at the NGAC in New Clark City,
in accordance with existing laws, rules and regulations. For this purpose, all concerned
offices shall formulate and adopt appropriate business continuity and financial plans,
including the operationalization of their respective back-up offices at the NGAC, in
case of a calamity capable of paralyzing government operations in the NCR.
To the extent consistent with their mandates and purposes, government-owned
or -controlled corporations (GOCCs) are encouraged to locate satellite or field offices
at the NGAC in New Clark City. In the same manner, the Legislative and Judicial
Branches of Government, and independent constitutional bodies, are encouraged to
establish appropriate offices thereat.
The foregoing shall be without prejudice to national government departments,
bureaus, offices and agencies, including GOCCs, transferring their respective Central
Offices at the NGAC in New Clark City, especially if their functions do not require their
main offices to be in the NCR.

Phases and Clusters for the Establishment of Satellite and Field
Offices. The establishment of satellite or field offices shall be done in phases and
clusters to be determined by the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management
Council, in coordination with the concerned offices.
The departments or agencies which have an existing regional, field or satellite
office within the vicinity of or proximate to the New Clark City may transfer their
regional office at the NGAC established herein, subject to existing laws, rules and
regulations.

Manpower Requirements. The manpower requirements for such
offices shall not be a basis for the creation of unnecessary redundant positions, and
shall be limited to those which are essential to the implementation of their respective
disaster contingency plans, and when warranted, the delivery of public services at the

Assistance for the Establishment of Offices at the NGAC. The
Bases Conversion and Development Authority shall assist concerned government
agencies in securing advantageous, c)st-efficient and flexible logistical and financial
arrangements relative to the establishment of their respective satellite or field offices

Funding. The budgetary requirements for the implementation of
this Order shall be sourced from available funds of the concerned agencies and
offices, and when appropriate and necessary, such other funding sources as the
Department of Budget and Management may identify, subject to existing policies,
budgeting, accounting and auditing laws, rules and regulations.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

Separability. In the event that any provision or portion of this Order
is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain
in force and effect.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately after its
publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation.
